property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any callee, C.transfer always returns true (completes without revert) because it only calls the callee exactly _tos.length times; the mutant using i<=_tos.length can attempt an out-of-bounds access and thus can revert for some inputs (when _tos.length>0).
change_summary: Change the for-loop condition to i<=_tos.length which causes an out-of-bounds access and will revert when _tos.length>0.
